about.en: CENT is the native coin of Incentiv, an EVM-compatible layer-1 network built around account abstraction, where user actions are processed as UserOperations through bundlers and an EntryPoint contract and fees can be sponsored or paid in supported assets through paymasters. CENT pays network fees and is also represented as an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xBBDE7EFB7a1AB3ED9122a14b33dC5C07D982367E and as a BEP-20 on BNB Smart Chain at 0x1E9A8531548aEd9b7fb83e80eF66422d182998C3.
